settlements.title: Neutrogena Skin360 $4.7M BIPA Class Action Settlement
settlements.summary:
Individuals who used Skin360 for a skin assessment in Illinois between Dec. 9, 2019, and May 5, 2023, may qualify to claim a cash payment from a settlement.

settlements.title: State Farm $8.8M Auto Insurance Class Action Settlement
settlements.summary:
Drivers insured by State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Co. in Washington state who received a payment for property damage under their underinsured motorist property damage coverage between Jan. 13, 2019, and Feb. 27, 2026, may be eligible to submit a claim for a cash payment estimated at $625 from a class action settlement.

Class members must meet the following criteria:

The accident occurred between Jan. 13, 2019, and Feb. 27, 2026.

Class members who had more than one qualifying accident may submit a separate claim for each qualifying accident. The settlement administrator will provide a claim form for each eligible accident.

Cash payment: Class members can submit a claim to receive a cash payment from the net settlement fund. The settlement administrator will determine the final payment amount using the individual and total vehicle repair costs and the total number of claims filed. The average payment amount is estimated to be around $625 per claim.

Class members who previously received a diminished value payment from State Farm will receive a reduced settlement payment.

To receive a settlement payment, class members can file a claim online or complete the claim form included with their notice and mail it to the settlement administrator. They must submit a claim form for each qualifying accident.

settlements.title: Finastra Technology $3.13 Million Data Breach Settlement
settlements.summary:
Individuals who received notice from Finastra Technology Inc. that an October 2024 data incident may have compromised their private information could be eligible to claim up to $2,500 plus credit monitoring from a class action settlement.

Class members include all individuals residing in the United States whose private information the October 2024 data incident at Finastra Technology may have impacted.

Cash payment for documented losses: Class members who experienced actual, documented out-of-pocket losses between Oct. 31, 2024, and Nov. 27, 2026, due to the data incident can claim up to $2,500. Eligible expenses include losses from identity theft or fraud, fees for credit reports or credit monitoring, costs to replace IDs and postage for contacting banks.

Credit monitoring: All class members can claim one year of CyEx Financial Shield Complete, which includes $1 million in financial fraud insurance and monitoring for identity theft, unauthorized transactions and high-risk activity.

To receive benefits, class members must file a claim online or print and complete the PDF claim form and mail it to the settlement administrator. Class members can also request a paper claim form from the settlement administrator.

Class members using the online claim form must provide the login ID and PIN from the settlement notice they received.

settlements.title: Renters Warehouse $195,000 Security Deposit Settlement
settlements.summary:
Individuals who rented or lived in a Minnesota property managed by Renters Warehouse and whom the company deducted money from their security deposit may be eligible to receive a cash payment from a class action settlement.

Eligible class members include individuals who meet all of the following criteria:

They vacated the property or moved out between May 31, 2019, and July 16, 2024.

There are two categories of class members based on the outcome of their security deposit:

Net positive class members: Those who had deductions from their security deposit but received some portion of the deposit back.

Net negative class members: Those who had deductions that exceeded their security deposit, resulting in no refund.

The settlement divides payments between the two categories of class members as follows:

Net positive class members: This category receives 90% of the net settlement fund distributed pro rata based on the amount of move-out charges Renters Warehouse assessed to each member in this group.

Net negative class members: This category receives 10% of the net settlement fund distributed pro rata based on the amount of move-out charges Renters Warehouse assessed to each member in this group.

settlements.summary:
The program itself is what is new. The Department and EisnerAmper, named in the notice as the Restitution Administrator, opened a notice and claims process in 2026, working from the available loan data, mailing and email records and address research to identify people who may be eligible. Claims run through November 24, 2026.

Eligibility turns on the program's own records rather than on a class definition. A person may be eligible if program records show they were a consumer borrower identified in the consumer loan data the FastBucks defendants provided to the State, and that they were adversely affected by the FastBucks business practices at issue.Legal

In practical terms, the notice tells anyone who took out one or more loans through FastBucks Holding Corporation between 2007 and 2016 that they may be eligible. Two routes lead into the claim process:

No documentation is required, and the claim form can be completed online by someone who never received a notice. The online form opens by asking whether the filer has a Claim ID Number and offers a route for each answer, so the Claim ID is not a gate on filing.
